summary: Iteration 2 (Remember-Me, DomainAnalysis View More toggles, JS-heavy scraper) tested end-to-end. Backend 15/15 pytest passing (100%): remember=true issues 1,296,000s cookies, remember=false/omitted issues 900s cookies. Full URL analysis on quotes.toscrape.com/js/ returned overall_score=28, word_count=249 (vs static ~17 -> Chromium fallback confirmed), 8 dimensions, real LLM answer citing Einstein/Marilyn Monroe/Eleanor Roosevelt. Frontend: remember-me-checkbox on Auth page produces browser cookies expiring in ~1295999s when checked and ~899s when unchecked; landing on /app in both. Domain Analysis on stripe.com renders 5 citation sources initially with toggle-citations 'View 5 more' -> expands to 10 -> 'Show less' -> collapses back to 5; same for toggle-prompts (5 -> 10). No regressions in prior AI endpoints (domain/visibility/citations/reddit/optimizer text).

minor.issue: Full request takes 40-70s. Behind the preview ingress (~60s cutoff) some JS-heavy URLs return 502 Bad gateway even though the analysis completes server-side. In-cluster (localhost:8001) it works. Consider (a) rendering the page async and returning a job id, or (b) tightening the Chromium networkidle wait, or (c) capping page.wait_for_timeout(1200) if word_count already >= threshold. Not a bug per se, but a user-visible risk for slow domains.

issues: Existing recharts ResponsiveContainer width(-1)/height(-1) warning on first render before data (already reported in iteration_1). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional, not new) URL analysis on JS-heavy pages can exceed 60s on the public preview -> returns 502 through Cloudflare ingress even though backend finished. Consider making /api/analyses (input_type=url) async (return job id + poll) or shorten Chromium wait_until to 'domcontentloaded' + a shorter fixed wait when body text already crosses 250 words.
(Optional, from iter_1) minHeight on chart containers to silence recharts width(-1) warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 709 lines - now at the 700-line split threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/optimizer.py, routers/geo.py, services/{llm,scraper}.py.

fetch_html() always tries Chromium render when static_words < 250. For short pages that are truly static-thin (e.g. an already-scraped microblog), this pays a 15-30s Chromium cold-start needlessly. Consider skipping render when the static HTML shows no <script src=> tags or has content-type text/plain.

render_html() uses wait_until='networkidle' + wait_for_timeout(1200). networkidle can hang for 30s on ad-tracker sites. Move to wait_until='domcontentloaded' and inspect word_count in-page, then bail early when >= threshold to keep the ingress under 60s.

REMEMBER_DAYS is a module-level constant (15). set_auth_cookies() correctly uses it. Access token TTL when remember=True is 15 days (long-lived JWT). This is a deliberate product choice but does mean a stolen access_token stays valid up to 15 days - worth flagging: rotate JWT_SECRET only invalidates them by discarding the refresh; consider a token version/jti allowlist for logout invalidation.
Cookies use SameSite=None; Secure; Partitioned - correct for the cross-site preview domain. httpOnly is set on both access + refresh - good.
Frontend DomainAnalysis.js: showAllCites/showAllPrompts state resets to false on new analysis AND on selecting a past report - good UX.
toggle button text uses (r.citation_sources.length - 5) directly. If citation_sources is exactly 5, the button hides (correct). If undefined it defaults to [] (correct).
server.py logout() only deletes cookies; if the frontend never calls logout (e.g. crashed tab), the 15-day access_token stays live. Acceptable for MVP but recorded.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL analysis on JS-heavy pages takes ~55s server-side; run it from http://localhost:8001 (Authorization: Bearer <token from Set-Cookie>) to bypass the ~60s preview ingress cutoff. Cookies with Secure; SameSite=None are NOT persisted by requests.Session on http://localhost - always extract access_token and pass as Bearer for localhost testing. Remember-me tests read Max-Age from response.raw.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie'). Toggle tests count children of [data-testid=citation-sources] and [data-testid=ranking-prompts]. pytest runs -n 2 loadscope in ~3 min for full suite.
rca of the issue: N/A - all iteration 2 features working. Only note: preview ingress ~60s cutoff makes UI-driven JS-heavy URL analysis a 502 risk; backend itself is correct.
